title: Flow family run state machine
diagram_text:
stateDiagram-v2

  running --> waiting_for_approval
  waiting_for_approval --> running
  running --> retrying
  retrying --> running
  running --> succeeded
  running --> failed
  running --> cancelled
  failed --> [*]

  cancelled --> [*]
